invariants: Project and actor read/edit authority is rechecked before every read/write; never derive ownership from caller text.
Sender and recipient operation identities, child, worktree, context and contract are resolved from the private run.
Writes are idempotent by scoped key and exact normalized payload; replay does not allocate or dispatch.

A definitive rejection can be archived locally only after exact disposition. An unconfirmed request can be explicitly retired through the matching run-revision CAS; the retirement readback or a later revision proves the original CAS cannot still commit. Retirement does not infer success from absence, and it never silently retries a request.
Messages are claims and evidence references only; coordinator ack is an attributed read receipt, not proof that the worker saw it and not approval, integration, execution or deployment authority.

Up to 512 retained messages per run, 200 review obligations, and 50 messages per read. A worker handoff may report up to eight addressed messages. Each reported message has a 1000-byte summary. Ack has no caller key: retry only after exact readback of message ack and run revision; never infer successful delivery from an uncertain response.

Legacy runs are explicitly legacy-unassessed. A contracted run needs a passed distinct-attempt review with a captured handoff and addressed finding before integration. A deliberate zero-write-scope review-only task is satisfied by its passed exact reviewer receipt and is never counted as a source merge; existing combined checks and acceptance still follow.

Reviewer role and candidate task are explicit approved contract fields. Empty write paths alone retain coding semantics. A failed finding requires its exact reserved repair attempt and a changed candidate before another pass; a later pass for unchanged source cannot erase it.

A reviewer operation stores the digest of the exact pending obligation delivered in its immutable capture at final claim. New assignments after capture refuse dispatch; passed resolution requires that stored delivered digest, a saved handoff, an addressed finding and reported candidate checks.

Reserved work is queued; dispatching without observed child is uncertain. Only positively observed running children are working. A complete owned handoff survives optional invalid/full addressed coordination and marks coordinationOmitted for explicit inspection.
New worker capture includes only messages addressed to its saved task and exact current context; prior captured bytes never change.

An optional bounded addressedMessages array in the existing version 1 worker handoff is captured after owned child retirement; the controller supplies immutable sender task, operation, child, worktree and handoff evidence. It never executes message text.
No read starts, reconciles or polls a provider. Unknown effects remain unknown; absent metrics are null, observed zero is numeric zero.
